releaseNotes: 修复 Codex 输入区重复挂件并统一为单一可见锚点；三个 Agent 的挂件仅在真实生成状态运动，空闲时暂停；补齐豆包 2.19.9 停止控件识别；移除 Codex 输入区多余直角边框，并重做清晰、简洁的圆形发送与停止按钮。
releaseNotesEn: Fixes duplicate Codex composer mascots by using one visible anchor; pauses mascot motion while all three agents are idle; recognizes the Doubao 2.19.9 stop control; removes redundant square composer borders; and redesigns the send and stop controls as clear single-layer circular buttons.
